rules.headings: Playfair Display, tracking-tight, font-black or font-light for contrast. NEVER use Inter.

visual_enhancers.hero_overlay: bg-gradient-to-r from-black/80 via-black/40 to-transparent (Never go darker flatly, let the image breathe on one side.)
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Glassmorphism' (Crystal Variant) for sticky headers: backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/60, border-white/10, shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)]. Use flat solid surfaces for standard cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add subtle grain/noise overlay to the background to break digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Cards: -translate-y-1, shadow-xl, border-white/20. Buttons: scale-105 transition-transform duration-300.

grids.implementation: Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with wide gap-8 to gap-12. Asymmetry creates tension. Never fill 100% perfectly. Leave breathing room.

layouts.hero: min-h-screen, asymmetrical content (left-aligned), bottom padding for scrolling.
layouts.menu_highlights: Bento Grid protocol. Mix tall, wide, and square cards. NEVER perfect equal squares.
layouts.vibe_section: Overlapping elements, large typography, generous padding (p-12 to p-24).
layouts.gallery: Masonry layout or staggered CSS grid. No perfectly aligned rows.
layouts.footer: py-24 or py-32, massive brand typography (text-[8vw]), high contrast dark background.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-full or rounded-lg). Primary CTA solid #E07A5F, Secondary CTA outline border-white/20 hover:bg-white/10.
components.cards: Cardless or max 8px border-radius (rounded-lg). Avoid Shadcn default card look. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for creative sections.
components.carousel: Use Embla Carousel (Shadcn) for testimonials, customized with dark theme and no visible outer borders.
components.navigation: Sticky top, crystal glass effect, logo left, links center, CTA right. Mobile: custom full-screen menu.

motion.general: Smooth, deliberate. Use framer-motion for page load reveals (y: 20, opacity: 0).
motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling if possible. Staggered entrance for grid items.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons scale up, images subtle scale on hover within overflow-hidden container.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient text-shadow or gradient overlay. APCA compliant.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-labels to all image placeholders and icon buttons.

media.image_aspect_ratios: Hero: 16:9 or full screen. Gallery: mixed (3:4, 4:3, 1:1). Menu: mostly 1:1 or 4:5.
media.loading: Lazy load all images below fold.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly necessary for this scope, but framer-motion 3D tilt effects on menu cards can add a premium feel.

hero_background.description: Luxurious dark room with green leather chesterfield sofa, representing the premium interior.

vibe_shisha.description: Men enjoying shisha in a cozy lounge.

promo_banner_bg.description: Assortment of gourmet dishes, perfect for lunch promo background.

generic_food_placeholder.description: Generic high-quality food spread to use for Avocado Cocktail, Qalayet Tomato, and Osmalya where specific images are missing. Apply different object-position styles to crop them differently. DO NOT USE dummyimage.com.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap. Use padding like p-12, p-24.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text or external placeholder services. Map missing specific images to the provided generic_food_placeholder.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install Playfair Display and Outfit fonts via Google Fonts import in index.css. Install lucide-react for icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.hero_section: Create a massive hero min-h-screen. The image should be full background with a dark gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-black/90 via-black/50 to-transparent) ensuring H1 and CTAs are readable on the left. Do not center-align the main text.
instructions_to_main_agent.business_lunch: Use a full-width banner layout. Use the promo_banner_bg image with a heavy dark overlay or a Glassmorphism card floating over it.
instructions_to_main_agent.menu_grid: Implement a Bento Grid (Tetris Grid). Use provided images for Fries, Nachos, Pasta. For Avocado Cocktail, Qalayet Tomato, Osmalya, use generic_food_placeholder but apply different crop/object-positions (e.g. object-[center_top]) so they appear distinct.
instructions_to_main_agent.vibe_section: Avoid standard 50/50 split. Make the image span 7 columns and the text span 5 columns, overlapping slightly with z-index manipulation.
instructions_to_main_agent.testimonials: Use a marquee (react-fast-marquee) for the 4.3 star reviews. Keep cards dark, minimal, borderless.
instructions_to_main_agent.footer: Include massive 'TCHI TCHI' text. Embed the Google map on one side. List the 24/7 hours prominently.
